answer: Split-tally bond stops fake identities. Each agent files one claim on a dune plot, locks 70 credits, splits its tally: knoll registry holds one half, lantern auditor the other. Each epoch a lantern-signed reading must tally both halves, or the bond burns. First 42, kth 42+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-halves ring fails: a borrowed half tallies once. Honest agents pay 42 once, keep the bond.
